The replacement character should naturally perform the exact same actions as the original woman. Motion and pose only — never copy the original outfit.

Do not alter any other person, object, background, camera movement, or scene element. Do not add or remove objects. The result should look like the original video was filmed with <Subject 1> wearing her maid outfit from the beginning.
